List third-party links. Use this tool to list links between a YouTube channel and a third-party service.

Usage:
  yutu thirdPartyLink list [flags]

Examples:
# List all third-party links
yutu thirdPartyLink list --parts snippet,status
# List links by linking token
yutu thirdPartyLink list --linkingToken abc123 --parts snippet,status
# List links by type
yutu thirdPartyLink list --type channelToStoreLink --parts snippet,status

Flags:
  -e, --externalChannelId string   Channel ID to which changes should be applied, for delegation
  -h, --help                       help for list
  -l, --linkingToken string        Linking token that identifies the YouTube account and channel
  -o, --output string              json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings              Comma separated parts (default [snippet,status])
  -t, --type string                Type of the link: linkUnspecified|channelToStoreLink
